topic: How to help your teen land their first dog walking client this week
caption:
Your teen could have their first paying client by the weekend.

Have them text 5 neighbors today offering dog walks for $15-20 a walk. That is it. No app, no resume, no experience needed.

Most teens land their first client within a few days just by reaching out to people who already trust your family.

HustleUp shows them exactly how to do this and a dozen other hustles. See how it works at hustleup.us
